title: JP Jet Ski Rental

Calm, beginner-friendly waters around Holmes Beach
Safety briefing covers local boating laws and channel markers
Must be at least 18 years old with valid government-issued photo ID
Riders born on or after January 1, 1988 must complete Florida Boating Safety Education course and carry certificate
Passengers can be younger but operators must meet age and licensing requirements
Florida law may require a boating safety education ID depending on age

blurb: Guests rent jet skis to explore the Gulf of Mexico, Anna Maria Sound, and local waterways around Anna Maria Island. All riders receive a safety briefing before launch covering controls, safety gear, and local boating laws. The rental includes well-maintained jet skis, life jackets, and local knowledge for a safe and enjoyable experience.
extraNote: Arrive 15 minutes early for check-in and safety briefing · Running late?
